superseded_attempts.issue: Initial preflight created a transient small CUDA context on physical GPU 0 because the shared seed helper initialized all visible CUDA devices.
superseded_attempts.impact: No external process was stopped; model compute used the free RTX 3090 on physical GPU 1. This prompted isolating the selected GPU before CUDA initialization.
superseded_attempts.resolution: Runner now selects a physical GPU at runtime and sets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES to that single device before CUDA initialization.

superseded_attempts.issue: Two starts after GPU isolation failed before data loading because torch.cuda.mem_get_info required an explicit logical device.
superseded_attempts.impact: No formal training was started and no external process was stopped.
superseded_attempts.resolution: Memory query now targets the selected logical device; the final isolated preflight completed successfully.
